issues.description: Method PersonService.addParent(Person person, Person parent): the problem statement (Part 4) and the template declare and describe addParent as returning a Person (the saved/updated person) and the tests and REST resource expect a returned Person (they assign the call result). In the solution implementation PersonService.addParent is declared as 'public void addParent(...)' (no return). This return-type mismatch between the solution implementation and the template/problem/tests (and the call sites in PersonResource and PersonServiceTest) will cause compilation errors at the call sites and confuses students about the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation of PersonService.addParent consistent with the problem statement, template, and tests by changing its signature in the solution to 'public Person addParent(Person person, Person parent)'. After adding the parent to person, return the persisted entity, e.g. 'person.getParents().add(parent); return personRepository.save(person);'. Alternatively, if the intended design is to have a void method, update all callers and the problem statement/tests to reflect a void return consistently; prefer returning Person to match the documented requirements and tests.
